page.overview:
What is Land of Ice?

The Land of Ice is a land mentioned, but not yet introduced. It is where Gecko Moria found Oars' frozen corpse.

Apparently the land was rather cold, living up to its name. The temperature was enough to kill the giant Oars when he was there, without the proper attire.

The only person with a connection to the island so far was Oars.

500 years ago, Oars went out onto the Land of Ice wearing nothing but a loincloth, and died from frostbite.
